releases.body:
First release: CLIProxyAPI account quota in the OpenCode 2.2 terminal UI (sidebar and footer).

- Configure the CLIProxy origin with the `url` option or `CLIPROXY_URL`, and the management key with an absolute `keyFile` option or `CLIPROXY_MANAGEMENT_KEY`. There are no defaults.
- Uses `GET /v0/management/auth-files` and `POST /v0/management/api-call` (tested against the CLIProxyAPI 8.0.x routes, v8.0.23 to v8.0.47, with fixtures only).
- Read-only; the key is never logged or sent to the terminal UI.
